newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Nokia launches new mobile phone in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Nokia launches new mobile phone in Asia.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy on Monday launched its 9000 Communicator - a combination mobile phone, fax, address book and mini-computer - in Asia on Monday.
"We chose Indonesia to get a better position in that market for Nokia," Juha Rema, assistant manager for the company's south Pacific operations, told a news conference.
Nokia had no plans to start manufacturing in Indonesia, however, Rema said.
"In Asia we have factories in China and South Korea...this capacity is sufficient," he said.

Husni Erwinn, Nokia's Indonesia country manager, said that the 9000 Communicator offers subscribers GSM mobile telephone facilities, a fax machine, Internet and electronic mail access, an address book, calculator and note pad. It will sell for 5.75 million rupiah in Indonesia.
The company gave no forecasts of projected sales.
